title: Monoallelic loss-of-function variants in ZNF536 are associated with a neurodevelopmental disorder with prominent behavioral features.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: abstract retrieved; Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500; supplementaryFiles endpoint returned a 297-byte non-zip response; no GEO/SRA/Zenodo/Dryad links; only text-mined IDs are OMIM 618037, transcript NM_014717.3 and ENST00000355537.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Cohort of 21 affected individuals with 18 unique heterozygous ZNF536 variants (15 predicted loss-of-function, 3 missense), inheritance data for 17 families, and a knock-in mouse model; all from the abstract.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found; supplement not retrievable via Europe PMC; individual clinical data in such case series are typically in supplementary tables or ClinVar only. Not checked in files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table seen; any label (pathogenic vs not, phenotype) would have to be assembled from case descriptions.

a3_inputs_present.note: Only variant descriptions per the abstract; no feature table found.

a4_units_stated.note: No measured quantity table available to check.

a5_enough_rows.note: Abstract states 21 individuals and 18 variants, far below the ~400-row minimum; not verified in files.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No files to compare against the paper's counts.

a8_label_provenance.note: Variant pathogenicity labels in case series are partly based on computational predictors ("predicted loss-of-function"), risking circularity.

honest_claim_h3: With 18 variants in one gene, no model claim is supportable; this is a clinical gene-disease association report.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use variant type and position in the gene ZNF536 to predict whether a patient has the neurodevelopmental disorder or specific behavioural features.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-patient variant and clinical features from the case series; 21 individuals per the abstract, not verified.
plain_idea.predict: Presence of clinical features (autism, intellectual disability, epilepsy) recorded by clinicians.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would help interpret new ZNF536 variants, but 21 patients cannot train or test a model.

ml_idea: None viable: a 21-patient single-gene case series with no deposited data table.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count of patients in the cohort (21 per abstract) already kills it.

verdict_reason: Clinical case series of 21 patients with 18 ZNF536 variants; no deposited dataset found, supplement not retrievable, far too few rows for ML (A1, A5 fail).
